I've updated the styles in `companies/Relay/src/index.css`. The previous `#root` element was manually scaled to 75% using `width: 133.333333%; height: 133.333333%; transform: scale(0.75); transform-origin: top left;`, which was causing the empty grey space on the right side and bottom.

I've reverted the `#root` CSS back to default `width: 100%; height: 100%;` and removed the hardcoded 75% scaling. This should make the site expand to use the full screen dimensions and remove the empty grey space.
